mapper.select: SELECT bi.*, u.user_name, u.avatar, u.phone, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM travel_collect WHERE type = 3 AND data_id = bi.id) as collectCount, EXISTS (SELECT * FROM travel_collect WHERE user_id = #{currUserId} AND type = 3 AND data_id = bi.id) as isCollect FROM travel_base_info bi LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON bi.user_id = u.user_id where bi.id = #{id}

SELECT bi.*, u.user_name, u.avatar, u.phone, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM travel_collect WHERE type = 3 AND data_id = bi.id) as collectCount, EXISTS (SELECT * FROM travel_collect WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 3 AND data_id = bi.id) as isCollect FROM travel_base_info bi LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON bi.user_id = u.user_id where bi.title like concat('%', #{keyword} ,'%') order by bi.create_time desc

SELECT DISTINCT tbi.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM travel_collect WHERE type = 3 AND data_id = tbi.id) AS collectCount FROM travel_base_info tbi JOIN travel_route tr ON tbi.id = tr.base_info_id JOIN travel_scenic_spot tss ON tr.scenic_spot_id = tss.id WHERE tss.location like concat('%', #{param.city} ,'%')
